title: 服务面：OpenAI 协议与多轮
hook_suggestion: 「引擎 37 章都拆完了，可用户敲的是 curl 不是 Python：一个 HTTP POST 怎么变成引擎请求、token 流又怎么变回 OpenAI 的 JSON 与 SSE？协议是无状态的——客户端每轮把全部历史原样重发，服务端凭什么不把重复前缀重算一遍、第二轮的 TTFT 不爆炸？推理模型这一轮的『思考』，下一轮的 prompt 里该留还是该丢——gpt-oss 用 analysis/commentary/final 三条通道把这件事写进了格式本身？还有那个最现实的：用户关掉浏览器的一瞬间，还在 GPU 上逐 token 烧的请求，谁去叫停？」（从 Part VIII hook『真实服务不止一个引擎』+ 章主题 serving 层/多轮/harmony + deepread/api-entry.json why_chains[6][4] 与 contracts 死亡传播段提炼为真问题；F5 断连反向 abort 本章回收）
scope_note: 本章解读 API 进程的「前门」——OpenAI 兼容服务层。主线 = 一个多轮 chat 请求在服务层的完整旅程：FastAPI 路由与装饰器 → ChatCompletionRequest 协议定型（to_sampling_params / output_kind 入口声明）→ handler 编排（Parser 装配 / 引擎健康预检 / request_id）→ 渲染交棒（非和谐 chat 模板回指 ch6；和谐 harmony 多轮编码本章展开）→ reasoning_ended 多轮预判 → engine_client.generate（EngineClient 抽象面，ch4 已立）→ 流式生成器逐 token 分拣（DelegatingParser 两阶段状态机 / HarmonyParser 三通道）→ SSE data 帧出门 / 非流式聚合 → 断连反向 abort 的 HTTP 层全貌（F5 回收）。旁线 = 启动链（先绑 socket → build_app → init_app_state → serve_http）与关停（drain/abort + watchdog）。边界：AsyncLLM 内部（add_request/双登记/output_handler/collector/detokenizer）ch4/ch6/ch7 已讲透，本章自 generate() 的 AsyncGenerator 消费侧接手；chat 模板与多模态渲染内部归 ch6（非和谐路径黑盒回指）；logprobs 组装归 ch8；ZMQ 拓扑归 ch5、多 API server/client_index 归 ch34（F3/F4 已回收）；/v1/responses 与 anthropic/cohere 面只在「API 面家族」一节点名不展开；beam_search、batch 端点、Mistral 特例、kimi_k2 id 连续性按 delete/省略处理。

stations.what: HTTP 进门：POST /v1/chat/completions → @with_cancellation + @load_aware_call 的 create_chat_completion——handler 任务与断连监听任务从第一行起就在竞速（F5 的 HTTP 端）；返回值三分支：ErrorResponse→JSONResponse(错误码)、ChatCompletionResponse→JSONResponse、异步生成器→StreamingResponse(text/event-stream)

handler 编排头：per-request Parser 实例化（ParserManager.get_parser 装配，gpt_oss 恒为 HarmonyParser）→ render_chat_request：_check_model(404) → errored 预检（流式 200 在生成前发出，死讯必须前置暴露）→ request_id = 'chatcmpl-' + X-Request-Id 头或 random_uuid

渲染交棒：tool_choice 门控（无 tool parser 时 auto/required/named 直接 400）；非和谐→validate_chat_template + preprocess_chat（chat 模板+tokenize，ch6 黑盒）；和谐（model_type=='gpt_oss'）→ parser.adjust_request + _make_request_with_harmony

harmony 多轮编码：preamble（system：reasoning_effort/起始日期；developer：函数工具表）→ parse_chat_inputs_to_harmony_messages 逐消息映射（assistant 正文→final、reasoning→analysis、tool_calls→commentary+recipient=functions.{name}、tool 结果→commentary to=assistant）→ auto_drop_analysis_messages 只留最后一个 final 之后的思考 → render_for_completion 出 token ids

协议定型：get_max_tokens 四方取 min（max_model_len−输入长/请求值/server 默认/平台上限）→ to_sampling_params：HTTP 字段装成 SamplingParams；stream 二值映射 output_kind=DELTA/FINAL_ONLY（ch7 三态契约的入口声明处）；server 默认 stop_token_ids（源码注释举 gpt-oss 的 </call> 为例）与请求值合并去重

多轮推理预判：reasoning_ended 三分支——include_reasoning=False→True；Mistral grammar→True；否则 parser.is_reasoning_end(prompt_token_ids)（多轮历史尾部若停在未闭合思考块内，生成就从思考里续）→ 盖进 EngineCoreRequest 过线；parse 侧对偶 = abstract_parser.py:L813-L825 首拍 prompt_reasoning_checked/adjust_initial_state_from_prompt

发车：generator = engine_client.generate(engine_input, sampling_params, sub_request_id, lora/priority/dp_rank/trace_headers/reasoning_ended)——只建协程不驱动，SSE 循环首个 async for 才真正 add_request（ch2/ch4 已立）；OpenAI 层只面向 EngineClient 抽象编程（engine/protocol.py:L41-L99）

流式收件与分拣：async for res（ch7 单槽邮箱 yield 的 RequestOutput）；首拍留底 num_cached_tokens；首块只发 role 空 delta；逐 output → parser.parse_delta 两阶段状态机（reasoning 段→转段→tool 段）/ 无 parser 直通 content；harmony 走三通道分拣（process_chunk 逐 token 喂 StreamableParser）；空 delta 首拍跳过（chunked prefill 不发空块）

断连反向 abort（F5 回收）：listen_for_disconnect 胜出 → handler/流生成器被 cancel → generate 捕 CancelledError/GeneratorExit → abort(q.request_id, internal=True) 两跳：本进程移状态 + 投 finish_reason=ABORT 终态解阻塞在等消费者（output_processor.py:L494-L515）→ 跨进程 ABORT 停算释放 KV；非流式全量路径捕 CancelledError 返回 'Client disconnected'（serving.py:L862-L863）

stations_note: 站号 = 一个多轮流式 chat 请求流经服务层代码的顺序（第 10 站为异常路径：客户端断连才走）；启动/关停链（api_server/launcher）不在站号内——它是「站 0」的舞台搭建与拆除，south 区呈现。正文按讲解需要编排：建议先立服务层鸟瞰（启动链 + 一图），再走站 1-7 的下行（进门→渲染→发车），随后站 8-9 的流式主戏（分拣 + SSE 出门 + 非流式对照），收在站 10 的 F5 回收（断连全链）与 WC5 多轮经济学回执。

key_classes.name: OpenAIServingChat
key_classes.responsibility: chat/completions 的 handler 主体（继承 GenerateBaseServing）：构造期经 ParserManager 装配 parser_cls（gpt_oss 恒 HarmonyParser）；_create_chat_completion 编排渲染→request_id→参数→generate→按 stream 分流；chat_completion_stream_generator 出 SSE、chat_completion_full_generator 出完整 JSON。

key_classes.name: OnlineRenderer
key_classes.responsibility: 在线渲染适配层：render_chat 做 tool_choice 门控后二分——非和谐走 preprocess_chat（chat 模板，ch6）/ 和谐走 _make_request_with_harmony（harmony 编码）；构造期同样装配 parser（use_harmony 由 model_type=='gpt_oss' 判定）；warmup 预热模板。

key_classes.name: HarmonyParser
key_classes.responsibility: DelegatingParser 特化子类：基于 openai_harmony StreamableParser 逐 token 解析 gpt-oss 输出；_SegmentType 把 analysis/commentary/final 三通道 + recipient 三分拣为 reasoning/content/tool_calls；process_chunk 出 Segment 流、parse_delta 组装 DeltaMessage、flush 收口与错误恢复；adjust_request 把结构化输出折叠进 final 通道 StructuralTag。

key_classes.name: Parser / DelegatingParser
key_classes.responsibility: 统一解析抽象：把 reasoning parser 与 tool parser 组合进一个接口（版本归属：统一层早于 v0.21.0 基线已落地——#32712（2026-02）；本章基线 v0.27.1 窗口内的新增是 harmony.py 的 HarmonyParser、kimi_k3、engine_based 流式，不是统一层本身）；DelegatingParser.parse_delta 两阶段状态机（StreamState 游标：prompt_reasoning_checked/reasoning_ended/tool_call_text_started）；非和谐模型的默认实现。

key_classes.name: ParserManager
key_classes.responsibility: 组合工厂：按 tool/reasoning 两个名字从各自注册表取类，动态组装一个 DelegatingParser 子类；is_harmony 恒返 HarmonyParser；kimi_k3 特化子类；都不配返 None（无 parser，流式直通 content）。

key_classes.name: ChatCompletionRequest
key_classes.responsibility: OpenAI chat 协议的 pydantic 模型（HTTP JSON 的类型层）；to_sampling_params 把协议字段装成 SamplingParams——stream→output_kind 二值映射是三态契约的入口声明；extract_structured_outputs 归一 response_format/json_schema 等约束。

key_classes.name: with_cancellation / listen_for_disconnect
key_classes.responsibility: 断连竞速装饰器（F5 的 HTTP 端）：handler 任务与断连监听任务 asyncio.wait(FIRST_COMPLETED)；返回 StreamingResponse 后监听移交响应对象。

key_classes.name: build_async_engine_client(_from_engine_args)
key_classes.responsibility: EngineClient 生命周期边界：AsyncEngineArgs → AsyncLLM.from_vllm_config（ch4 在线面入口），async with 保证任何退出路径 shutdown；多 API server 时携 client_count/client_index。

key_classes.name: serve_http / watchdog_loop / terminate_if_errored
key_classes.responsibility: uvicorn 启动与优雅关停：server_task + watchdog_task + handle_shutdown（SIGINT/SIGTERM → engine.shutdown(timeout) → should_exit；timeout==0 为 abort 模式否则 drain）；watchdog 每 5s 检引擎死、兜底流式生成器吞异常的场景。

key_classes.name: EngineClient
key_classes.responsibility: handler 依赖的抽象协议（ABC）：generate/encode/abort/check_health/pause_resume/shutdown 等方法面 + renderer/input_processor/model_config 暴露；AsyncLLM 是全仓唯一实现——OpenAI 层只面向此抽象编程（ch4 站 1 已立）。

why_chains.decision: 客户端断连 = 取消 generate 协程 = 反向 abort：把「没人看的请求」从引擎里抠掉（F5 本章回收）
why_chains.old_design: v0 AsyncStream.generator 在 GeneratorExit 时 cancel（依赖生成器被关闭才触发）；HTTP 层没有主动监听断连的统一机制。
why_chains.pain: HTTP 客户端中途断开（用户关页面、超时、重试换路）后，若不显式 abort，引擎会继续为幽灵请求逐 token 烧 GPU——batch 场景下这是真实吞吐损失：每个断连请求白白占一个 batch 位直到 max_tokens。
why_chains.solution: 三层接力：① 路由层 with_cancellation 让 handler 任务与 listen_for_disconnect 竞速，断连则 cancel handler（vllm/entrypoints/serve/utils/api_utils.py:L52-L94 与 L37-L49——v0.27.1 已从 entrypoints/utils.py 移到 serve/utils/；挂在 POST /v1/chat/completions 上，chat_completion/api_router.py:L51-L53）；② StreamingResponse 取消传导为 generate() 的 CancelledError/GeneratorExit → await self.abort(q.request_id, internal=True)（async_llm.py:L611-L616）；③ abort 两跳落地（async_llm.py:L729-L738）——本进程 OutputProcessor.abort_requests 移状态并给 collector 放一条 finish_reason=ABORT 的终态输出（output_processor.py:L494-L515，防止还在等的消费者卡死），再 engine_core.abort_requests_async 跨进程通知引擎停算。非流式全量路径同样接 CancelledError → 'Client disconnected' 错误响应（chat_completion/serving.py:L862-L863）。ch7 站 14 已埋引擎侧半句话；本章补全 HTTP 层全貌：StreamingResponse 接管断连监听（with_cancellation docstring 原话 'In the case where a StreamingResponse is returned by the handler, this wrapper will stop listening for disconnects and instead the response object will start listening for disconnects'）与时序竞争细节（abort 终态依赖 collector 存活，与 generate finally q.close() 的竞争由内部 id 幂等兜住）。
why_chains.cost: 每请求多一个竞速任务（listen_for_disconnect 持续读 receive 通道）；abort 是异步的——断连到引擎真停之间还差一次 IPC + 引擎当前 step，期间仍会算出若干废 token（浪费有界但不为零）；with_cancellation 的安全前提是 body 已被 FastAPI 读走（docstring 明言 unsafe elsewhere）。

why_chains.decision: RequestOutputKind 三态契约——使用面在入口声明消费方式，本章是 chat 面的声明处：stream=True→DELTA、stream=False→FINAL_ONLY
why_chains.old_design: v0 没有这个维度——引擎对每个请求每步都产完整输出，流式与否的差异全靠 API 层消化；v1 初版的 SamplingParams 也没有 output_kind（PR 历史中后补）。
why_chains.pain: 离线批处理与非流式 HTTP 根本不需要每 token 的中间输出——照样生产、照样跨进程传、照样排队，是每 token 每请求的纯浪费（CPU + IPC + 内存）；流式 SSE 恰恰相反，要的就是增量。
why_chains.solution: chat_completion/protocol.py:L722-724：to_sampling_params 里 output_kind=(RequestOutputKind.DELTA if self.stream else RequestOutputKind.FINAL_ONLY)——同一个 handler，流式/非流式只是入口处一个二值声明；OutputProcessor 照单裁剪（FINAL_ONLY 且未完→中间输出零构造，ch7 m13 已立裁剪侧）。非流式 full_generator 因此敢 async for 聚合只留最后一个（它就是全部）；流式逐 delta 出门。
why_chains.cost: 所有下游（logprobs 切片、metrics）都要感知这个轴；与 n>1 扇出（ch7 m15）和 stream_interval 节流叠加时分支组合变多；两路代码（stream_generator vs full_generator）在 serving 层各写一遍 finish_reason 仲裁——协议同构但实现分叉。

why_chains.card: deepread/api-entry.json contracts「死亡传播」段 + launcher.py 源码注释（本章拼装）
why_chains.decision: 流式的错误语义：200 已发不可改码 → 三道防线把死讯送到客户端——渲染前 errored 预检、流中错误降级为 data 帧、watchdog 兜底关停
why_chains.old_design: 朴素做法：等生成器抛异常让框架回 500。流式下行不通——FastAPI 在 handler 返回 StreamingResponse 时就发出 200 状态行，之后异常只能断流或塞进流里。
why_chains.pain: 流式 200 与真正开始生成之间有时序差：客户端拿到 200 却等不到任何 token，无法区分慢与死；StreamingResponse 生成器吞掉异常后 uvicorn 也不会自杀，服务器带死引擎空转（launcher.py:L171-172 docstring 原话 'Needed to trigger shutdown if an exception arises is StreamingResponse() generator'）。

async def listen_for_disconnect(request: Request) -> None:
    """Returns if a disconnect message is received"""
    while True:
        message = await request.receive()
        if message["type"] == "http.disconnect":
            # If load tracking is enabled *and* the counter exists, decrement
            # it. Combines the previous nested checks into a single condition
            # to satisfy the linter rule.
            if getattr(
                request.app.state, "enable_server_load_tracking", False
            ) and hasattr(request.app.state, "server_load_metrics"):
                request.app.state.server_load_metrics -= 1
            break


def with_cancellation(handler_func):
    """Decorator that allows a route handler to be cancelled by client
    disconnections.

    This does _not_ use request.is_disconnected, which does not work with
    middleware. Instead this follows the pattern from
    starlette.StreamingResponse, which simultaneously awaits on two tasks- one
    to wait for an http disconnect message, and the other to do the work that we
    want done. When the first task finishes, the other is cancelled.

    A core assumption of this method is that the body of the request has already
    been read. This is a safe assumption to make for fastapi handlers that have
    already parsed the body of the request into a pydantic model for us.
    This decorator is unsafe to use elsewhere, as it will consume and throw away
    all incoming messages for the request while it looks for a disconnect
    message.

    In the case where a `StreamingResponse` is returned by the handler, this
    wrapper will stop listening for disconnects and instead the response object
    will start listening for disconnects.
    """

    # Functools.wraps is required for this wrapper to appear to fastapi as a
    # normal route handler, with the correct request type hinting.
    @functools.wraps(handler_func)
    async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        # The request is either the second positional arg or `raw_request`
        request = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else kwargs["raw_request"]

        handler_task = asyncio.create_task(handler_func(*args, **kwargs))
        cancellation_task = asyncio.create_task(listen_for_disconnect(request))

        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(
            [handler_task, cancellation_task], return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED
        )
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()

        if handler_task in done:
            return handler_task.result()
        return None

    return wrapper
embed_excerpts.what: 断连竞速双任务（F5 回收的核心一）：listen_for_disconnect 持续读 request.receive() 等 http.disconnect 消息；with_cancellation 把 handler 包成任务与监听任务 asyncio.wait(FIRST_COMPLETED) 竞速——先完成者取消另一个。docstring 三条要点原话：不用 request.is_disconnected（与中间件不合）；沿 starlette.StreamingResponse 模式；返回 StreamingResponse 后监听移交响应对象。注意 v0.27.1 该文件已从 entrypoints/utils.py 移到 serve/utils/api_utils.py。

async def render_chat_request(
        self,
        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
    ) -> tuple[list[ConversationMessage], list[EngineInput]] | ErrorResponse:
        """
        Validate the model and preprocess a chat completion request.

        Delegates preprocessing logic to OnlineRenderer, adding the
        engine-aware checks (LoRA model validation, engine health).

        Returns:
            A tuple of (conversation, engine_inputs) on success,
            or an ErrorResponse on failure.
        """
        error_check_ret = await self._check_model(request)
        if error_check_ret is not None:
            logger.error("Error with model %s", error_check_ret)
            return error_check_ret

        # If the engine is dead, raise the engine's DEAD_ERROR.
        # This is required for the streaming case, where we return a
        # success status before we actually start generating text :).
        if self.engine_client.errored:
            raise self.engine_client.dead_error

        return await self.online_renderer.render_chat(request)

def _make_request_with_harmony(
        self,
        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
        should_include_tools: bool = True,
    ):
        """Build Harmony (GPT-OSS) messages and engine prompt from a chat request."""
        reuse_ids = _reused_prompt_token_ids(request)
        if reuse_ids:
            # Decode-side token reuse: feed the forwarded ids straight to the
            # engine. Harmony has no adjust_request hook to preserve.
            engine_input = tokens_input(reuse_ids, cache_salt=request.cache_salt)
            return [], [engine_input]

        messages: list[OpenAIMessage] = []

        # because of issues with pydantic we need to potentially
        # re-serialize the tool_calls field of the request
        # for more info: see comment in `maybe_serialize_tool_calls`
        _mt.maybe_serialize_tool_calls(request)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

        chat_messages = list(request.messages)
        instructions, chat_messages = extract_instructions_from_messages(chat_messages)

        # Add system message.
        # NOTE: In Chat Completion API, browsing is enabled by default
        # if the model supports it. TODO: Support browsing.
        assert not self.supports_browsing
        assert not self.supports_code_interpreter
        if (reasoning_effort := request.reasoning_effort) == "none":
            raise ValueError(f"Harmony does not support {reasoning_effort=}")
        tools = request.tools if should_include_tools else None
        messages.extend(
            build_harmony_preamble(
                instructions=instructions,
                tools=tools,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort,
                with_custom_tools=should_include_tools,
            )
        )

        # Add remaining conversation messages.
        messages.extend(parse_chat_inputs_to_harmony_messages(chat_messages))

        # Render prompt token ids.
        prompt_token_ids = render_for_completion(messages)
        engine_input = tokens_input(prompt_token_ids, cache_salt=request.cache_salt)

        return messages, [engine_input]

def parse_chat_inputs_to_harmony_messages(chat_msgs: list) -> list[Message]:
    """
    Parse a list of messages from request.messages in the Chat Completion API to
    Harmony messages.
    """
    msgs: list[Message] = []
    tool_id_names: dict[str, str] = {}

    # Collect tool id to name mappings for tool response recipient values
    for chat_msg in chat_msgs:
        for tool_call in chat_msg.get("tool_calls", []):
            tool_id_names[tool_call.get("id")] = tool_call.get("function", {}).get(
                "name"
            )

    for chat_msg in chat_msgs:
        msgs.extend(parse_chat_input_to_harmony_message(chat_msg, tool_id_names))

    return msgs


def auto_drop_analysis_messages(msgs: list[Message]) -> list[Message]:
    """
    Harmony models expect the analysis messages (representing raw chain of thought) to
    be dropped after an assistant message to the final channel is produced from the
    reasoning of those messages.

    The openai-harmony library does this if the very last assistant message is to the
    final channel, but it does not handle the case where we're in longer multi-turn
    conversations and the client gave us reasoning content from previous turns of
    the conversation with multiple assistant messages to the final channel in the
    conversation.

    So, we find the index of the last assistant message to the final channel and drop
    all analysis messages that precede it, leaving only the analysis messages that
    are relevant to the current part of the conversation.
    """
    last_assistant_final_index = -1
    for i in range(len(msgs) - 1, -1, -1):
        msg = msgs[i]
        if msg.author.role == "assistant" and msg.channel == "final":
            last_assistant_final_index = i
            break

    cleaned_msgs: list[Message] = []
    for i, msg in enumerate(msgs):
        if i < last_assistant_final_index and msg.channel == "analysis":
            continue
        cleaned_msgs.append(msg)

    return cleaned_msgs

def parse_chat_input_to_harmony_message(
    chat_msg, tool_id_names: dict[str, str] | None = None
) -> list[Message]:
    """
    Parse a message from request.messages in the Chat Completion API to
    Harmony messages.
    """
    tool_id_names = tool_id_names or {}

    if not isinstance(chat_msg, dict):
        # Handle Pydantic models
        chat_msg = chat_msg.model_dump(exclude_none=True)

    role = chat_msg.get("role")
    msgs: list[Message] = []

    # Assistant message with tool calls
    tool_calls = chat_msg.get("tool_calls", [])

    if role == "assistant" and tool_calls:
        content = flatten_input_text_content(chat_msg.get("content"))
        if content:
            commentary_msg = Message.from_role_and_content(Role.ASSISTANT, content)
            commentary_msg = commentary_msg.with_channel("commentary")
            msgs.append(commentary_msg)

        reasoning = chat_msg.get("reasoning")
        if reasoning:
            analysis_msg = Message.from_role_and_content(Role.ASSISTANT, reasoning)
            analysis_msg = analysis_msg.with_channel("analysis")
            msgs.append(analysis_msg)

        for call in tool_calls:
            func = call.get("function", {})
            name = func.get("name", "")
            arguments = func.get("arguments", "") or ""
            msg = Message.from_role_and_content(Role.ASSISTANT, arguments)
            msg = msg.with_channel("commentary")
            msg = msg.with_recipient(f"functions.{name}")
            # Officially, this should be `<|constrain|>json` but there is not clear
            # evidence that improves accuracy over `json` and some anecdotes to the
            # contrary. Further testing of the different content_types is needed.
            msg = msg.with_content_type("json")
            msgs.append(msg)
        return msgs

    # Tool role message (tool output)
    if role == "tool":
        tool_call_id = chat_msg.get("tool_call_id", "")
        name = tool_id_names.get(tool_call_id, "")
        content = flatten_input_text_content(chat_msg.get("content")) or ""

        msg = (
            Message.from_author_and_content(
                Author.new(Role.TOOL, f"functions.{name}"), content
            )
            .with_channel("commentary")
            .with_recipient("assistant")

@classmethod
    def get_parser(
        cls,
        tool_parser_name: str | None = None,
        reasoning_parser_name: str | None = None,
        enable_auto_tools: bool = False,
        model_name: str | None = None,
        is_harmony: bool = False,
    ) -> type[Parser] | None:
        """
        Get a Parser that handles both reasoning and tool parsing.

        Composes individual reasoning and tool parsers into a single
        DelegatingParser subclass.

        Args:
            tool_parser_name: The name of the tool parser.
            reasoning_parser_name: The name of the reasoning parser.
            enable_auto_tools: Whether auto tool choice is enabled.
            model_name: The model name for parser-specific warnings.
            is_harmony: Whether the selected model uses the Harmony format.
                        If True, HarmonyParser is always returned.

        Returns:
            A Parser class, or None if neither parser is specified.
        """
        if not tool_parser_name and not reasoning_parser_name:
            return None

        reasoning_parser_cls = cls.get_reasoning_parser(reasoning_parser_name)
        tool_parser_cls = cls.get_tool_parser(
            tool_parser_name, enable_auto_tools, model_name
        )

        if reasoning_parser_cls is None and tool_parser_cls is None:
            return None

        if is_harmony:
            from vllm.parser.harmony import HarmonyParser

            HarmonyParser.reasoning_parser_cls = reasoning_parser_cls
            HarmonyParser.tool_parser_cls = tool_parser_cls
            return HarmonyParser

        if reasoning_parser_name == "kimi_k3" or tool_parser_name == "kimi_k3":
            from vllm.parser.kimi_k3 import KimiK3Parser

            r_cls = reasoning_parser_cls
            t_cls = tool_parser_cls

            class _KimiK3Parser(KimiK3Parser):
                reasoning_parser_cls = r_cls
                tool_parser_cls = t_cls

            return _KimiK3Parser

        from vllm.parser.abstract_parser import DelegatingParser

        r_cls = reasoning_parser_cls
        t_cls = tool_parser_cls

        class _Parser(DelegatingParser):
            reasoning_parser_cls = r_cls
            tool_parser_cls = t_cls

        return _Parser

async def run_server(args, **uvicorn_kwargs) -> None:
    """Run a single-worker API server."""

    decorate_logs("APIServer", skip_if_decorated=True)

    # Interrupt initialization if SIGTERM arrives before uvicorn installs its
    # own signal handlers. Once uvicorn is running it replaces this.
    def _interrupt_init(*_) -> None:
        raise KeyboardInterrupt("terminated")

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _interrupt_init)

    listen_address, sock = setup_server(args, reuse_port=False)
    await run_server_worker(listen_address, sock, args, **uvicorn_kwargs)


async def run_server_worker(
    listen_address, sock, args, client_config=None, **uvicorn_kwargs
) -> None:
    """Run a single API server worker."""

    if args.tool_parser_plugin and len(args.tool_parser_plugin) > 3:
        ToolParserManager.import_tool_parser(args.tool_parser_plugin)

    if args.reasoning_parser_plugin and len(args.reasoning_parser_plugin) > 3:
        ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser(args.reasoning_parser_plugin)

    async with build_async_engine_client(
        args,
        client_config=client_config,
    ) as engine_client:
        shutdown_task = await build_and_serve(
            engine_client, listen_address, sock, args, **uvicorn_kwargs
        )
    # NB: Await server shutdown only after the backend context is exited
    try:
        await shutdown_task
    finally:

async def watchdog_loop(server: uvicorn.Server, engine: EngineClient):
    """
    # Watchdog task that runs in the background, checking
    # for error state in the engine. Needed to trigger shutdown
    # if an exception arises is StreamingResponse() generator.
    """
    VLLM_WATCHDOG_TIME_S = 5.0
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(VLLM_WATCHDOG_TIME_S)
        terminate_if_errored(server, engine)


def terminate_if_errored(server: uvicorn.Server, engine: EngineClient):
    """
    See discussions here on shutting down a uvicorn server
    https://github.com/encode/uvicorn/discussions/1103
    In this case we cannot await the server shutdown here
    because handler must first return to close the connection
    for this request.
    """
    engine_errored = engine.errored and not engine.is_running
    if not envs.VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH and engine_errored:
        server.should_exit = True
